title: Vintage 1971 Playboy Playmate Wall Calendar Jill Taylor Complete 12 Months
condition_description: Complete, all 12 months, no writing or marks. Light age toning and a few small spots on the back cover; spiral binding intact. See photos.
description:
Vintage 1971 Playboy Playmate wall calendar, spiral bound, (c) 1970 HMH Publishing Co. January features Jill Taylor.

COMPLETE: all 12 months present, with no writing, circled dates or other marks. Light age toning and a few small spots on the plain back cover - see photos.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. Ships flat in a plain, protective mailer.
